registry.title: Register

fileOnly: This official does not appear in the rankings (an assistant referee, or retired): here is their register file.

documents.title: Documents
documents.staffHint: Licences, medical certificates, identity papers: check every document filed.
documents.selfHint: File your documents here; the federation checks them and lets you know.

documents.emptyHint: Documents filed by the official or the federation appear here.

mine.title: My file
mine.hint: Your contact details and areas covered. The rest of the file is kept by your federation.

errors.birthDate: Invalid date (the official must be at least 16).
errors.duplicate: An official already has this registration or licence number.

conflicts.selfHint: Declare any link with a club, team or country: you will not be designated on their matches.
conflicts.staffHint: Declared links: the engine keeps the official off the matches concerned.
conflicts.declared: Link declared: the engine will take it into account.
conflicts.emptyHint: A former club, a relative who coaches, a second nationality: declare it before you are designated.
